answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with slashable identity bonds paired with random audits: each agent locks one stake to hold one vote, and verifiers periodically demand proof of unique work. When an auditor checks who genuinely mapped the lagoon, the terrace, and the inlet, cloned identities cannot produce independent raw traces, so their bonds are slashed and paid to honest reporters. To pass off k fakes an attacker must lock k separate bonds, and even a modest audit rate makes the expected slashing loss exceed any reward.
